overview_description.description: Spiko provides a digital financing platform that enables users to earn daily interest on their cash at the risk-free rate. It offers flexible accounts where users can deposit and withdraw funds without fees or penalties. The platform aims to provide straightforward cash management solutions for entrepreneurs, CFOs, and individuals, with funds secured by Treasury Bills and held by a banking partner.
